content:
The UPESSC UP Super TET Primary Syllabus 2026 is for Assistant Teacher candidates targeting the Class I to V primary level.

Primary Level Subjects

  • Child Development and Pedagogy
  • Language and Communication
  • Mathematics
  • Environmental Studies
  • General Knowledge and Current Affairs

Download the official Class I to V syllabus PDF below and verify the final subject-wise scheme in the latest UPESSC notification.
